say:2:1310707001:1.text: How can it be over? The festival has just begun.
say:2:1310707001:1.source_cn: 结束？怎么会结束呢，祭典才刚刚开始！
say:2:1310707001:1.male: How can it be over? The festival has just begun.
say:2:1310707001:1.female: How can it be over? The festival has just begun.

say:4:1310707003:1.text: Look, there are snowball fights, snowmen-building activities, and ice skating... Oh, there's even a scary event at the hot springs inn called the Ghostly Getaway!
say:4:1310707003:1.source_cn: 你瞧，打雪仗、堆雪人、滑冰……对了，在温泉旅馆里还有鬼...

say:5:1310707004:1.text: After the masquerade ball, the Archduke will select this year's "Chosen One". The entire festival will officially end when that person completes the lighting ceremony at the ice sculpture.
say:5:1310707004:1.source_cn: 化装舞会之后，大公阁下就会选出今年的“受选者”。等受选...
